cards.title: Multi-Board Tabs Feature
cards.notes:
Support multiple named boards (Work, Claude Code, etc.) with a tab strip in the titlebar. --- DATA MODEL --- New kanban.json: { boards: [{ id, label, columns, cards }] } Auto-migration in readData(): old {columns,cards} shape wrapped in "Main Board" --- PHP (server.php + mcp.php) --- 1. Add defaultColumns() helper; update defaultData() + readData() with migration block 2. Add getBoardById(data, id) -> index helper 3. New board routes: GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/boards 4. All column+card routes gain ?boardId= query param 5. POST /api/import falls back to boards[0] (Chrome ext compat) --- JAVASCRIPT --- - Expand state: boards[], activeBoardId (localStorage) - Rewrite poll(): fetch /api/boards first, resolve active board, then parallel fetch columns+cards with ?boardId= - New functions: renderTabs(), switchBoard(), addBoard(), deleteBoard() - ~8 existing api() calls get ?boardId= appended --- HTML --- Insert
between .ghost-title and .win-btns --- CSS --- - Fix .ghost-title: flex:1 -> flex:0 0 auto (critical or tabs get crushed) - ~60 lines of new #board-tabs styles: pill tabs, horizontal scroll, +/x buttons, glass overrides --- MCP (mcp.php) --- - Mirror all PHP helper changes - New tools: list_boards, add_board, switch_board - Add optional board_id param to all existing card/column tools --- PITFALLS --- - ghost-title flex MUST change or tabs are invisible - switchBoard() must zero lastColumnsJson/lastCardsJson or poll short-circuits - switchBoard() must remove any open .modal-backdrop

cards.title: PBUG: Recurring donors email profile link: When clicking on "Manage your donor profile here" as a super user you get logged into another users profile
cards.description:
When receiving the order information email and clicking on the 'Manage your donor profile here' as a super user, you get logged into a User profile that is not yours. (Let me know if you need further information) 
Email is also attached in this HS ticket incase you can't open the one I added below. 
This is happening because the User ID for the Super user is the same as the User profile id. we need to make sure that when a super user clicks the link for the User profile it's not logging them into a different user. 
I attached a word doc below with an example of a link. When I (jodi) click the link in cbo.io I am taken into the user profile for  Becky Sanchez
Jasmine clicked the link and was taken into Chris Lowe

Clicked link in email and I get logged in to Becky's profile.

cards.title: PBUG: /butler/bidder-lookup.php: Updated "add a selection" from manage guests/guest update link not showing in butler lookup
cards.description:
to resolve this issue: when a selection is updated in manage guests or via guest update link and a bidder is looked up in the butler, the selection should show

HS issue: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/22025730/record/2-10533000/47926890813/view/1?engagement=104142551959&type=NOTE

Lauren: what I THINK Melissa is saying is she created "Add a Selection" questions to be asked on the Individual Ticket Purchases. After having a meeting with Jodi last week, she learned that the questions needed to be on the guest not the ticket. (this is talking about Custom Questions) she then went through all of their Custom Questions and updated their answers to be on the selection. But some aren’t showing up in Butler. To sum it up it sounds like the "Add a Selection" selections are not showing up in the Butler as they should. One ex. that I found in this Account is Jay Abrams, they have a selection selected but its not displaying in Butler. One thing I noticed when testing last week is it will not display unless you are a Bidder however in this ex. they are a Bidder:

Lindsay: 

It looks like updating a selection from manage guests (and from the guest update link for the actual add a selection, not custom question) is not showing on the butler look up.  
 

Marty:

If I'm understanding this right, this is working as intended and isn't a bug. When a guest is turned into a bidder, the selection (if there is one) is copied to the bidder's "notes" field. The notes field is just a text field and can be updated at any point on the bidder record. Because someone can add/remove data that may or may not be related to a selection, we don't touch that field after the bidder is created. we've never shown the selection there (butler lookup). Only in the bidders' notes when its created from a guest.

 
Update: Changed to feature request to display the selection from a linked guest record when a guest has been turned into a bidder.

cards.title: SEC: Dependabot: Security issue with Axios library
cards.description:
Dependabot flagged a security issue with Axios: "Axios is Vulnerable to Denial of Service via __proto__ Key in mergeConfig"

Update Axios to version 1.13.5

For testing, this is a spot check of AJAX calls in bidapp (e.g. get item details, place a bid, etc.). This is another case of if one works, they all work.

cards.title: FEAT:/tickets/guest_update: Do not allow a guest record to have the same phone/email as another guest
cards.description:
When purchasing a ticket the purchaser has to add a unique email and phone number that is not the same as any other guest in their list. 

Would like to do the same on the Guest Update Link page. When a guest record is being updated on the guest update link page do not allow the same phone/email to be added to multiple guests in that record. 

Example: I have 6 guest records displaying, each one has to have their own email/phone number, no duplicates should be allowed.

cards.title: FEAT: Organization: Account: Stripe tax calculation - add 'taxability override' to API call for exempt customers
cards.description:
It would be ideal to ensure that our tax exempt customers have their status included in tax calculations. It appears possible to pass the tax id of the org but I think that only applies to the customer record, which may not exist until after the sale takes place, or at least until after the tax calculation takes place.
https://docs.stripe.com/api/tax/calculations/create#calculate_tax-customer_details-taxability_override

In this code example it shows the ability to indicate tax override. this would be applied if our org account record has charitable, religious or educational exemption selected:
// Set your secret key. Remember to switch to your live secret key in production.
// See your keys here: https://dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys

$calculation = $stripe->tax->calculations->create([
  'currency' => 'usd',
  'line_items' => [
    [
      'amount' => 1000,
      'reference' => 'L1',
    ],
  ],
  'customer_details' => [
    'address' => [
      'line1' => '920 5th Ave',
      'city' => 'Seattle',
      'state' => 'WA',
      'postal_code' => '98104',
      'country' => 'US',
    ],
    'address_source' => 'billing',
    'taxability_override' => 'customer_exempt',
  ],
]);

More detail:

it will apply any time a license is being purchased - wherever the tax calculation API is being called now, this one line needs to be added to the tax calculation call whenever an exemption exists for the org:

'taxability_override' => 'customer_exempt',

in the API call where it is shown in the example call in this ticket description.  I would think this would be the account page as well as create organization.  And of course, if the org has 'no exemption' then don't include this in the tax calculation call.

For testing, I'd 1st try Michigan orgs to show that charitable, educational, and religious exemptions result in zero tax due to customer exemption. I'm not 100% sure if this will work since I'm forcing tax calculation in MI.  you'll be able to look at the transaction and see the taxability reason, like this one, but it should show customer exempt instead of product exempt




If MI still charges tax, that's probably my setup of the test account rather than a code failure. I have just set up a registration for PA in test mode that should charge tax under normal taxable circumstances so that should also be a good test when exemptions are declared.

Looking in prod, I see the customer record at least has the exemption on it, but the tax calculation record does not appear to. I'm also not seeing the EIN on the customer record which I would prefer to have included if we can. here's one *customer* record from prod:

Metadata

organization_id

11174

tax_exempt_status

Charitable

but here is the tax transaction - showing no tax ID


If it's easier, I might suggest that we create the customer record first, even if we don't have a payment method yet. that might make it easier to tie the exemption to the tax calculation - something for dev to consider.

LMK if you still need more detail or clarification or discussion.

cards.title: FEAT: admin/email_bidders: Composed Email: Change "Sent to" drop down list to a paginated and searchable list
cards.description:
Marty suggestion after fixing AXO 7344:
When clicking the "Sent To" button under Email Bidders>Composed Email> Sent on Column, it can take a long time and potentially break with a 504. We should change the "Sent To" list from loading everything all at once to a paginated and searchable list.
